meta.title: Veterans — REP | IV
meta.description: Free, verified profiles for military veterans. SkillBridge internships, civilian translation help, and career resources — all from verified employers only.

hero.headline: Your next
hero.subheadline: REP | IV is free for every veteran. Verified employers only. No fees, no scams, no noise.

items.title: A free, verified profile
items.body: Your profile is manually reviewed by our team. Military service, rank, MOS, and transition timeline are all confirmed before you appear on REP | IV — so employers know exactly who they're talking to.

items.title: SkillBridge internships
items.body: We surface SkillBridge-approved opportunities from verified partner companies. If you're within 180 days of separation, you can start building civilian experience before you're out.

items.title: Civilian translation help
items.body: Military experience doesn't always map cleanly to a job description. We help you frame your MOS, leadership roles, and operational experience in language civilian hiring managers understand.

verification.headline: Verified with
verification.body: We confirm your service without asking for anything sensitive. We will never ask for your Social Security number. Any documents you upload for verification — DD-214, orders, or service records — are deleted from our systems immediately after review.

steps.title: Submit your profile
steps.body: Add your branch, rank, MOS or rate, years of service, and transition timeline. No SSN required at any step.

steps.title: Upload a verification document
steps.body: A DD-214 (Member 4 copy), separation orders, or equivalent. We accept redacted copies — only branch, dates, and character of discharge need to be visible.

steps.title: Document deleted after review
steps.body: Once our team confirms your service, your uploaded document is permanently deleted. We keep only the verified status and the service details you chose to display on your profile.

neverAsk.text: Payment of any kind to apply or get verified

resources.headline: Tools for the
resources.body: Every verified veteran on REP | IV gets access to these resources at no cost.

items.title: MOS translator
items.body: Enter your MOS, rate, or AFSC and get a plain-language summary of equivalent civilian roles and skills.

items.title: SkillBridge directory
items.body: Browse SkillBridge-approved internships from verified partner companies, filtered by location, industry, and branch.

items.title: Resume review
items.body: Submit your resume for a free review by our team. We flag military jargon and suggest civilian-friendly language.

items.title: Transition timeline guide
items.body: A step-by-step guide to the 180-day window before separation — what to do, when to do it, and who to contact.

veteranReady.label: Veteran-ready
veteranReady.body: Companies with this badge have confirmed they actively recruit veterans and understand military experience. They've been reviewed by our team.

skillbridge.label: SkillBridge Partner
skillbridge.body: Companies with this badge are approved SkillBridge partners. They can host transitioning service members in internship roles before separation.

cta.headline: Your service
cta.body: REP | IV is always free for veterans. Create your profile, get verified, and connect with employers who understand what you bring.
